annotations.text:
PlateFind redesign — Modern Dashboard direction.
The desktop and phone artboards are live: click states on the map or plates in the list to mark them, use the header chip to flip online/offline, flick the headlight switch for dark mode, and hit Reset to see the confirmation. The chips above each frame set theme, accent and how many states start found.

Real Albers USA projection (Census state boundaries), not a tile grid — Alaska and Hawaii ride in the standard insets. The eight states too small to tap get labelled callouts out in the Atlantic; both the shape and its tag toggle the same state.
Below: the two flows worth pinning down before this gets built — the destructive reset, and every state the connection chip can be in.
